text: At its meeting on February 4, 2025, the Board approved the Community Partnership Policy and instructed the CEO to further explore partnerships with local and community groups and to report back. This report summarises the community partnership engagements/commitments for 2025 and reflects on the overall progress of these collaborations between Exhibition Place and community organizations and individuals. The report will highlight key successes of the policy, including notable partnerships, attendance, community impact, and in-kind support provided.
The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Received the report (January 19, 2026) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place, for information.
